name: Seated barbell wrist curl

contraction_interpretation: Task-level joint-action classification; not directly measured fascicle length or tension.

name: Seated barbell reverse wrist curl

name: Behind-the-back barbell wrist curl
setup_definition: Standing; elbows mostly fixed; movement at wrist.

contraction_interpretation: Task-level joint-action classification; not directly measured fascicle length or tension.

name: Barbell reverse curl
setup_definition: Pronated grip; elbow flexion; wrist held stable.

contraction_interpretation: Task-level joint-action classification; not directly measured fascicle length or tension.

name: Barbell reverse preacher curl
